senses.gloss:
औदुम्बर a. (-री f.)
 [उदुम्बर-अञ्]
—1 Made of, or coming from, the Udumbara tree.
—2 Made of copper; पात्रमौदुम्बरं गृह्य Mb. 13. 125. 82.

औदुम्बर + .{@-रः@} [P. IV. 2. 67.]
—1 N. of a region abounding in Udumbara trees.
—2 A form of Yama, the god of death.
—3 Made of copper.
—4 A class of ascetics solely living on whatever fruits they see first
 early in the morning; Bhāg. 3. 12. 43.
औदुम्बर + .{@-री@} A branch of the Udumbara tree.

औदुम्बर + .{@-रम्@}
—1 The wood of the Udumbara tree.
—2 The Udumbara fruit.
—3 A kind of leprosy.
—4 Copper or a copper-vessel; Mb. 5. 40. 10.
औदुम्बरकः A place full of Udumbara trees.
औदुम्बरायणः N. of a grammarian. इन्द्रियनित्यं वचनमौदुम्बराणः Nir.
